documents.title: Accounting policy (extract)
documents.body:
1. Depreciation is charged on a straight-line basis from the day the asset is commissioned, inclusive, pro rata to the number of days in the month.
2. Salaries are paid on the 25th for the 1st to the 25th; the remaining days of the month (in Nov 2026 — 5 days) are accrued at month end and released with the next payroll run.
3. Expenses under contracts that span the period end are allocated evenly by calendar day.
4. Outstanding foreign-currency liabilities are revalued at the reporting-date rate; the difference is charged to foreign exchange differences.
5. Fixed-asset capitalisation threshold: 50,000. Below the threshold — expense of the period.
6. Prepaid expenses (insurance policy) are amortised in equal monthly instalments over the policy term.
7. The payroll accrual is released with the next payroll run.
8. Closing adjustments are posted on the last day of the period, including corrections of omissions in prior months of the current year.
